name: Adjustment Date
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last adjusted or updated in the system. This captures the exact moment of change to inventory data, used for audit and traceability purposes.

name: Adjustment Reason
description: A textual explanation for a variance or discrepancy observed during inventory or picking operations. Provides context for why the adjustment was made.

name: Amount In INR
description: The amount of money charged in Indian Rupees (INR) for the transaction.

name: Attempt Number
description: The sequential attempt number made to process a payment, where 1 represents the first try and higher values indicate subsequent retries.

name: Bill
description: A unique identifier for each bill, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number. This identifies the specific bill to which the line belongs.

name: Bill Reference
description: A reference code linking the transaction to a specific invoice or bill issued by a business.

name: Booked Product Quantity
description: The number of units of a product that were initially booked or reserved, representing the planned quantity to be received.

name: Booked Product SKU
description: The product SKU that was originally booked or reserved in the system, indicating the item expected to be received.

name: Cases In Shipment
description: The number of individual cases or containers included in a shipment, indicating the physical volume of goods being shipped.

name: Cases Quantity
description: The number of cases (standard packaging units) associated with the product in a given slot. Represents packaged units in inventory.

name: Case Units
description: The number of individual units (e.g., packs) that are packed together in a single case or carton. Used for inventory batching and logistics planning.

name: Case Weight In Kilograms
description: The total weight in kilograms of all products contained within one case, used for logistics and inventory management. Critical for shipping and handling calculations.

name: Confirmation Method
description: The method or process used to confirm the presence or status of a product, such as a slot label scan.

name: Confirmed Quantity
description: The number of cases that have been confirmed and matched against the ordered quantity for a product.

name: Container
description: A unique 12-digit barcode identifier assigned to a specific container or shipment, used for tracking physical goods in logistics systems.

name: Cost Price In Indian Rupees
description: The total cost incurred to acquire or produce one unit of the product, expressed in Indian Rupees, used for profitability calculations.

name: Customer Complaint
description: The date and time when a customer complaint was first recorded or submitted.

name: Customer Order
description: A unique identifier for each customer order, formatted with a prefix indicating the order type and date.

name: Delivery
description: The timestamp indicating when a delivery was made. This captures the exact moment of delivery execution, useful for tracking timing and scheduling patterns in the delivery process.

name: Delivery Quantity
description: The total number of individual units of a product delivered. This reflects the quantity of items, such as bottles or loaves, delivered to a customer.

name: Distribution Center Slot
description: The specific storage location within a distribution center where the product is held, identified by a unique slot code. Used for inventory tracking and retrieval.

name: Forecast
description: The specific date when the inventory forecast or data record was created or observed. This is the primary timestamp for the forecast entry, indicating when the prediction was generated or last updated.

name: Global Trade Item Number
description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product across supply chains and retail systems. Used for interoperability with external retailers and logistics partners.

name: Goods Receipt Note
description: A unique identifier for a Goods Receipt Note, representing the specific document that records the receipt of goods. This is the primary key or reference for a single goods receipt event.

name: Gross Revenue INR
description: The total revenue generated from all transactions before any deductions or refunds.

name: Initiated Date And Time
description: The timestamp when the transaction was first initiated or started by the system.

name: Inventory Control
description: The inventory level at which a new order must be placed to avoid stockouts, based on lead time and demand variability.

name: Inventory Count
description: The timestamp indicating when the inventory count was performed.

name: Inventory Date
description: The specific day for which inventory data is recorded. This represents the timestamp or date of the inventory snapshot.

name: Inventory On Hand
description: The number of units of a product available in inventory at the end of a specific day.

name: Inventory Status
description: The current quantity of a product that is physically available and on hand in inventory at a given point in time.

name: Item
description: A global trade item number uniquely identifying a specific product or SKU scanned during checkout. Used for product identification at point of sale.

name: Item Line
description: The sequence number of an item within a single shipment or receipt, indicating its position in the delivery list.

name: Item Line (store014.store.pos_lines)
description: The sequence number of the item line within a single bill, indicating its position in the list of items. Used to order items on a receipt or invoice.

name: Merchant Discount Rate Fee INR
description: The total merchant discount rate (MDR) fee paid to the payment processor for processing transactions.

name: Net Revenue INR
description: The final amount of revenue received after deducting refunds and merchant discount fees.

name: Notice Weight In Kilograms
description: The total weight of the shipment in kilograms as declared or noted in the shipping documentation.

name: Order
description: A unique identifier for each customer order, formatted as SO- followed by a date and number.

name: Order Line
description: The sequence number of the item within an order, indicating its position in the order line items.

name: Order Line (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: The sequence number indicating the position of an item within a larger order or shipment, such as line 1, 2, etc., reflecting order structure.

name: Order Quantity
description: The number of cases originally ordered for a specific product item in an order.

name: Order Reason
description: The reason for the creation or processing of the order, currently indicating automation triggered by a system rule.

name: Order Timestamp
description: The exact date and time when an order was initially created in the system.

name: Packaging Quantity
description: The total number of crates used to pack and transport the delivered goods. This reflects packaging volume and logistics efficiency.

name: Pack Unit
description: The unit of measurement for the product's individual packaging, such as weight or volume, indicating how much is contained per pack.

name: Pallet
description: A 12-digit serial number uniquely identifying a pallet or container in the shipment, used to track physical inventory movement.

name: Pallet SSCC
description: A unique identifier for a specific physical item or product unit, typically used to track individual shipments or products in a warehouse.

name: Payment Bill ID
description: A unique identifier for each bill transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and suffix indicating the billing session and sequence number.

name: Payment Initiated At
description: The exact timestamp when the payment transaction was initiated or attempted.

name: Payment Note
description: Additional free-text information or comments associated with the transaction, such as error messages or special instructions.

name: Pick Confirmation
description: The timestamp when a pick operation was completed for an order, indicating the actual time of fulfillment activity in the warehouse process.

name: Product
description: A unique identifier for a specific product, such as a type and size of food item.

name: Product Details
description: Details about the product and quantity ordered in a purchase order.

name: Product Expiry
description: The date by which the product must be consumed or used, as per its expiration. This ensures compliance with freshness and safety standards.

name: Product Flow Path
description: The movement path of the product through the supply chain, indicating whether it flows directly to customers (DC) or through a distribution center (DSD).

name: Product Name
description: The full product name including type, ingredient, and size, as displayed to customers in the marketplace or store. This is the customer-facing name of the product.

name: Product Quantity Shipped
description: The number of units of a product specified in the Advance Shipping Notice, representing the quantity shipped for that item.

name: Product SKU
description: The specific product SKU listed on the Advance Shipping Notice, indicating the type of item being delivered.

name: Product SKU (store014.store.inventory_book)
description: A unique identifier for a product, such as a type of food item or ingredient, formatted with a code that indicates its category and size.

name: Product SKU (store014.store.products)
description: A unique identifier for a product variant, such as its type and size, used to distinguish different offerings in the inventory. This is a core identifying field for product variants within the system.

name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.pick_confirmations)
description: A unique product identifier for a specific item, such as type and size of commodity.

name: Product (store014.store.forecasts)
description: A unique identifier for a specific product item, such as a type of grain or spice, based on its category and size. This identifies the product being forecasted.

name: Product (store014.store.fresh_deliveries)
description: The product identifier representing a specific item, such as milk or bread, with its size and type. This uniquely identifies the product being delivered.

name: Product (store014.store.stock_counts)
description: The unique product identifier for a specific item, such as a type of grain or spice, including its size and variety.

name: Product (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A product identifier representing a specific item or variant, such as a type of spice or sugar with defined packaging size.

name: Purchase Order
description: A unique identifier for each sales order, formatted as a string with a prefix indicating the order type and a numeric suffix.

name: Receipt Event
description: The exact timestamp when goods were received at the receiving location, marking the time of entry into inventory.

name: Receipt Verification Method
description: The method used to verify and record the receipt of goods, specifically scanning a pallet label (SSCC) against a shipping notice.

name: Refund
description: A unique identifier for each refund transaction, formatted as RF followed by a numeric sequence.

name: Refunds Amount INR
description: The total amount of money refunded to customers due to returned or canceled transactions.

name: Route
description: The unique identifier for the delivery route that a shipment was assigned to. This identifies the path or area served by a delivery team or vehicle.

name: Sale
description: The date when a sales transaction occurred.

name: Selling Price In Indian Rupees
description: The selling price of the product in Indian Rupees, as quoted to customers at point of sale or online marketplace. Used for pricing and revenue calculations.

name: Settlement Date
description: The date when payments are settled and funds are transferred to the business.

name: Shelf Audit
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated or audited.

name: Shipment
description: A unique identifier for a shipment, representing the specific delivery or transport event associated with the goods.

name: Shipment ID
description: A unique identifier for a shipment, used to track and reference the entire batch of goods being transported from one location to another.

name: Shipment Quantity
description: The total number of cases (standardized containers) included in a shipment or order line.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.pick_confirmations)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as SHP- followed by a date and number.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipments)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a sequence number.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with a prefix indicating the shipment code and date.

name: SKU
description: A unique identifier for a specific product item, such as a type of produce or food item. This identifies the product being managed in stock adjustments.

name: Status Updated Date And Time
description: The timestamp when the status of the transaction was last updated or changed.

name: Storage Slot
description: The storage location or bin slot where the product is stored within a warehouse or rack system. This helps track physical placement of inventory items.

name: Tender Method
description: The method of payment used, such as cash, card, or UPI.

name: Till Status
description: The outcome status of the payment processing, indicating whether it was approved, declined, or failed due to no response.

name: Transaction Amount In Indian Rupees
description: The total amount of money involved in the transaction, expressed in Indian Rupees.

name: Transaction Reference Number
description: A unique reference number assigned by the till system to identify and track each transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.

name: Transaction Reference Number (store014.payments.psp_upi_report)
description: A unique identifier assigned to each transaction, typically used to track and reference a specific payment or invoice.

name: Transaction Status
description: The current state of the transaction, indicating whether it was successful, failed, or returned to the sender.

name: Units Quantity
description: The total number of individual units (e.g., pieces or items) contained within the product, including negative values for discrepancies. Reflects actual inventory count with potential variances.

name: UPI Credits Count
description: The total number of UPI transactions processed during the period.

name: Value At Cost In INR
description: The total monetary value of the product at cost, expressed in Indian Rupees, reflecting its financial worth. Used for inventory valuation and cost tracking.

name: Warehouse Slot
description: The physical storage location within a warehouse where a product is stored or picked from.

name: Weight Check Status
description: A status field indicating whether a physical weight check has been performed for the shipment, with 'not weighed' meaning no actual weight measurement has been taken yet.

name: Write Off
description: The date when the inventory item was written off.
